recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is; no core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-6181 unless a future work-group decision intentionally reopens code whitespace semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-6181 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I DSTU1 technical correction saying the code datatype regex [^\s]+([\s]+[^\s]+)* allowed multiple whitespace characters despite prose allowing no whitespace other than single spaces.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 5627, represented in git by e98f119211c45993a393fafe1f38b00a0d079b02 (#6181 - fix code regex), which changed source/datatypes/primitives.xml from the multiple-whitespace pattern to [^\s]+([\s][^\s]+)*.
additional_context: Later Published code-regex issues refined the same rule: FHIR-9031 repeated the multiple-whitespace concern, FHIR-13764 removed the optional-whitespace catastrophic-backtracking form, and FHIR-25413/FHIR-37406 moved current source/display to the stricter literal-space regex [^\s]+( [^\s]+)*. FHIR-13764, FHIR-25413, and FHIR-37406 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/datatypes/primitives.xml currently contains [^\s]+( [^\s]+)* for code, source/datatypes.html displays [%regex code%], and source/fhir.ini routes datatypes through the active datatype page.
